title: 大明演义 06 · 北京保卫战：于谦的孤注一掷

chapters.title: 危城
chapters.narration: 皇帝被俘的消息传回北京，朝堂上哭成一片。二十万精锐在土木堡损失殆尽，京师只剩老弱士卒不到十万。有官员翻出星象图，说天命已去，主张赶紧迁都南京——跑，成了很多人的共识。

broll.prompt: A panicked Ming imperial court in a storm-lit hall, weeping officials, an open map of the realm on the floor, chaos and fear
Officials packing scrolls and valuables, southbound boats being readied at a river dock, panic
Beijing city walls with few defenders, grey winter sky over empty ramparts, vulnerability

chapters.bg: rain-streaked palace hall windows, cold grey-green anxious wash

chapters.title: 于谦
chapters.narration: 就在这时，兵部侍郎于谦站了出来：言南迁者，可斩！京师乃天下根本，一动则大事去矣。他升任兵部尚书，紧急调两京、河南的备操军，山东沿海的备倭军入卫，又命通州的粮草由士兵自取运进北京——兵和粮，都有了。

broll.prompt: A resolute Ming minister in official robes standing tall in a panicking court, arm raised, a beam of light on him, dramatic cinematic composition
Soldiers mustering at Beijing city gates, wagons of grain, busy mobilization
Grain carts lining the road from Tongzhou, soldiers carrying rice sacks, pragmatic logistics

chapters.bg: a resolute figure before a stormy court, single light beam, dark dramatic wash

chapters.title: 新君
chapters.narration: 更大的手笔是换皇帝。也先手里的英宗，从奇货变成了废牌——孙太后拍板，郕王朱祁钰即位，遥尊英宗为太上皇。你手里的牌不值钱了，这仗的主动权，就回到了大明手里。

chapters.title: 兵临
chapters.narration: 十月，也先挟着太上皇破紫荆关，直扑北京。于谦列阵九门之外，背城而战，并下令：临阵，将不顾军先退者，斩其将；军不顾将先退者，后队斩前队。军令如山，二十二万人无路可退。

broll.prompt: Mongol cavalry pouring through a mountain pass, captured imperial banners dragged along
Vast Ming army arrayed in formation outside all nine gates of Beijing, banners and cannons, the city wall behind, epic wide shot
An executioner raising a blade at a fleeing officer outside the ranks, strict discipline, grim

chapters.bg: Beijing city walls with nine gates under an overcast sky, martial grey-gold wash

chapters.title: 大捷
chapters.narration: 也先主力猛攻德胜门，于谦设伏空屋，神机营火器骤发，铅弹炮石如雨——也先的弟弟孛罗中炮而死。西直门、彰义门连日血战，城上百姓掷砖石助战。五天五夜，北京城岿然不动。

chapters.title: 退兵
chapters.narration: 各地勤王军陆续将至，也先怕归路被断，夜里拔营北逃。于谦遣兵追击，夺回被俘百姓上万。这场北京保卫战，大明赢了——赢回了脸面，也赢回了士气。

Ming cavalry pursuing retreating Mongols across frost fields, capturing prisoners and cattle
Beijing gates opening at dawn, returning soldiers with captured horses, celebration

chapters.title: 夺门
chapters.narration: 1450年，也先求和，放回了太上皇。可弟弟景泰帝把他软禁进南宫，一关就是七年。1457年景泰病重，石亨、徐有贞、曹吉祥撞开南宫大门，拥英宗复位——史称夺门之变。

broll.prompt: A locked southern palace courtyard, the retired emperor gazing at a small patch of sky, deep shadows
A sick emperor on his bed with anxious ministers, dim candlelight
Torch-lit night coup: soldiers forcing open palace gates, shadows storming the hall, dramatic cinematic composition

chapters.title: 清白
chapters.narration: 复辟的第一件事，就是杀于谦。徐有贞说：不杀于谦，此举无名。抄家的官员打开于谦的家——家无余财，只有正屋锁着的蟒袍和剑器。天下冤之。粉骨碎身浑不怕，要留清白在人间——他少年时的诗，成了谶语。你怎么看于谦的选择？评论区聊聊。
